headline: I Built an AI Studio That Turns 1 Line of Text Into a 5-Minute Short Drama
summary: This open-source platform generates scripts, storyboards, voiceovers, and 1080p video from a single creative prompt, leveraging LLMs and advanced compositing.
details: An open-source platform called Shortify AI has been developed to create short drama episodes from a single text prompt. The system handles scriptwriting, illustration, voiceover, and video compositing, outputting a full 1080p video.

The pipeline begins with an LLM generating a structured script, focusing on dialogue-centric formatting for more engaging narratives. It supports various OpenAI-compatible LLMs through a model resolver layer.
Image generation for storyboards uses appearance descriptors to maintain character consistency across shots. Images are stored securely on Tencent Cloud COS.

Voiceovers are generated using LLM scripts to assign voices to characters. The system features a fallback mechanism, switching from iFlytek WebSocket to Edge-TTS if rate limits are encountered, ensuring a rapid voiceover stage.

The compositing pipeline integrates AI video generation with a robust fallback system. When AI video generation fails, it defaults to static images with dynamic camera movements (Ken Burns effect) or a solid fallback with subtitles.
The entire process is managed via a single CLI command, which reads drama metadata, processes each episode and shot through the four-stage pipeline, and uploads the final product to cloud storage.

While AI video generation has a failure rate, the platform prioritizes a reliable fallback chain. The compositing pipeline, particularly FFmpeg's zoompan filter and drawtext, ensures no black screens, even if AI video generation falters.

The system offers a significantly faster production time compared to earlier methods. Episodes with static images and camera motion can be rendered in approximately 2 minutes, a stark contrast to the 20 minutes required with earlier AI video generation attempts.

The developer emphasizes that while AI content generation is becoming fast and cheap, the bottleneck is now in the compositing pipeline. Investing in a robust compositing solution is crucial for building scalable AI video platforms.
The platform is built using Next.js 16, FFmpeg, and PostgreSQL, and requires only a GLM API key to start, with other stages utilizing free tiers or graceful fallbacks.

headline: Prime Day Kindle deals offer up to 36% off Paperwhite, Colorsoft, and Kids models
summary: Amazon's Prime Day runs from June 23-26, featuring significant discounts on popular e-readers like the Kindle Paperwhite, Colorsoft, and Kids editions, with some models under $100.
details: Amazon's Prime Day Kindle deals are live from June 23 to June 26, offering up to 36% off. This sale event is a prime opportunity to purchase a new Kindle e-reader at its best price, with deals running for almost a full week.

The Kindle Paperwhite, Amazon's top e-reader, is included in the sale. It features a 7-inch screen with an adjustable warm front light, up to 12 weeks of battery life, and excellent contrast. Both regular and Signature versions, which adds wireless charging and auto-adjusting light, are discounted.

For those seeking color, the Kindle Colorsoft is also on sale. This model offers a muted color screen, a feature shared with its Kids version and the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft. The sale makes it a good time to buy, especially since it recently gained a true Dark Mode.

The 11th-generation Kindle, available for under $100, is smaller with a 6-inch screen and lacks the warm front light. Despite this, it's a powerful and snappy option, uniquely offered in a matcha green color.

Kindle Kids models are also discounted, including specific Paperwhite and Colorsoft Kids versions. These come with kid-focused content like six months (Paperwhite Kids) or a full year (Colorsoft Kids) of Kids+ subscription, offering books for ages 3-12.
